conformance_minimum.cost_if_refused: 2 files, <1 hour. Refusal must additionally name: (a) which measured defect class it would not have caught — share-halving (arithmetic, not parsing), stringify scale crash (volume, not shape); (b) what is lost — turn-count divergence insurance (A02 miss, three-artifacts-three-counts) recurs silently; a SyntaxError-class break in any reader goes unnoticed until a human runs it (as happened TODAY in usage-shape/bin).
conformance_minimum.form: (1) ONE golden transcript fixture (markers + no-markers + empty content + missing usage + multi-assistant + unknown row type) carrying a reader-contract@v1 stamp; (2) ONE agreement test: all three readers parse it and emit IDENTICAL turn/session skeletons (counts, indices, models, usage fields) — divergence is RED; (3) version refusal: unknown contract stamp refused, mirroring unknown-capabilities-version-refused. No matrices, no envelopes, no per-adapter records — those serve external plural authors, of which we have zero.
conformance_minimum.studied: skillranker/tests/adapter_contract.rs (793 lines, READ-ONLY vendored): per-adapter contract records + strict parsers (unknown version/keys/duplicates refused) + pinned goldens + unverified-cannot-inherit. The portable core is version-stamp-plus-refusal and golden agreement; the rest is external-author machinery we do not need.
